answer: Audits are logged in saffron, queued in quartz, and garden publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 29 identities per epoch. A farm of 45 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2504 identities would post 3435 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
